title: Tracto Contract Schema Version Catalogue
description: Declares the current supported schema major. A previousMajor entry is added only when a second major is actually published.
notes: Stage 1 begins with one schema major (v1). N/N-1 compatibility applies when a second major is published. Until then, conformance tests verify that an artifact with a schemaVersion outside the supported range is rejected with a VALIDATION error and a republish diagnostic.
